paper_title: Searches for signatures of ultra-light axion dark matter in polarimetry data of the European Pulsar Timing Array
notes: EPTA pulsar polarimetry birefringence search for ultra-light ALP dark matter constraining g_agamma over mass range 6e-24 to 5e-21 eV. Values extracted from text: frequentist best-sensitivity ~5e-13 GeV^-1 at 8e-24 eV (conclusions; note Sec V quotes 4e-14 GeV^-1, internal inconsistency), Bayesian conservative best 2e-13 GeV^-1 at 3e-23 eV. Actual limit curves are in Fig.7/Fig.10 (not numerically tabulated). DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. 95% C.L. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.6, 4))
